is_anopheles.evidence: The study protocol describes entomological evaluations on Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles funestus (page 3, page 7).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The protocol states that 'Published kdr resistant markers will be typed by PCR [31,32]' (page 7), but no actual genotyping of target markers was conducted or reported in this manuscript.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No mosquito genotype data, allele counts, or genotype frequencies are reported; this is a trial protocol.

african_field_population.evidence: Although the planned field study is located in rural Burkina Faso, no mosquitoes were tested or reported in this protocol paper.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a study protocol describing the design and methodology for a future cluster-randomised trial (Trials 16:113), not a primary empirical study with results.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study site is defined south of the road from Banfora and Sideradougou (10° 56' 00" N, 004° 46' 00" W) in Burkina Faso (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The trial was planned across two transmission seasons in 2014 and 2015 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Study protocol without reported empirical dataset.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed because the manuscript is an empirical protocol without results.

assessment.summary: This is a study protocol for the AvecNet cluster-randomised controlled trial assessing the addition of pyriproxyfen to permethrin LLINs in rural Burkina Faso. No empirical marker genotyping or bioassay data are reported.
exclusion_reasons: Study protocol containing no primary empirical genotype or bioassay data.
Does not report any target resistance marker genotype data.
